verdict.rationale: There is no documented data-export or offboarding feature. A user could extract data programmatically: the List Events API supports batch retrieval of events (instead of webhooks), and a public OpenAPI spec and official CLI imply JSON access to account objects. Missing for 10: a documented bulk/full-account export, explicit open-format (e.g. CSV) export, offboarding or account-closure portability guidance, and independent corroboration of complete data extraction.
